entries.26ae8746a4ef27a2: The company sells its core cutting tools as well as measuring instruments, industrial equipment, machine tools, etc. It also promotes sales of its original brand “Victory end mill,” runs inspection and calibration services for measuring instruments, and holds exhibitions at the NaITO Technical Center.

entries.385e7b55b32214e7: As its management philosophy, the company states that it aims to provide “optimal products and best service” to business partners in Japan and overseas, and to contribute to the development of industry as a whole through technological innovation in manufacturing. From March 1, 2026, the company launched its Medium-Term Management Plan “Kyōsō Vision 2030” and will put into practice the concepts of “Create,” “Connect,” “Tie” and “Expand,” evolving from conventional sales to providing value from the user’s perspective.
entries.49cb9d691f111e1a: The company handles manufacturers of cutting tools, measuring instruments, industrial equipment, machine tools, etc. The company is carrying out sales promotion plans with its key manufacturers and strengthening initiatives with newly handled manufacturers.
entries.513d300990292812: The company, together with its consolidated subsidiary NAITO VIETNAM CO.,LTD., its affiliate SOMAT Co.,Ltd. and Fujinaka Kōgu (Shanghai) Co., Ltd., forms a group of 4 companies in total. The consolidated number of employees for the fiscal year ended February 2026 is 309.
entries.52b65c05f2e71724: Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥43,518 million, down 0.1% year on year. By product category, cutting tools accounted for ¥22,311 million, industrial equipment and machine tools for ¥17,280 million, and measuring instruments for ¥3,926 million.
entries.5fe0263f90c0eee0: Its strengths lie in holding a wide range of inventory for its core cutting tools, with a system for prompt delivery to meet diverse customer needs, and in the convenience of its sales network of its head office and 29 locations, its information network with customers, and EDI linkage. The technical center, which hosts measurement and cutting exhibitions, is also used as a venue for proposals.
entries.6bf0a86e5954d8c8: This is a single-segment business that sells cutting tools, measuring instruments, industrial equipment, machine tools and other products, and performs related operations. The company, its consolidated subsidiary NAITO VIETNAM CO.,LTD., and its affiliates SOMAT Co.,Ltd. and Fujinaka Kōgu (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. make up the group, four companies in total. Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥43,518 million.
entries.6bf26b9c594b676e: Its main products are closely linked to the automotive industry, and it sells them to manufacturing customers in Japan and overseas. No customer accounts for 10% or more of consolidated revenue.
entries.849164b737cf3535: The 4 key challenges of the new Medium-Term Management Plan are: expanding sales that do not depend on conventional distribution flows, based on inventory and systems; evolving sales to move beyond price competition; reforming overseas operations into businesses that contribute to profit; and building new businesses not bound by the existing wholesale model.
